name: Combobox
summary: Text field with an autocomplete listbox.

a11y.keyboardNote: Re-measured in a browser on 29/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: ArrowUp, ArrowDown. ArrowUp is delivered by the engine and the ficha did NOT declare it — the merge of the two lineages had reverted the ficha to a three-key list, and this measurement is what caught it. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: Enter, Escape. Space is out of the count by category, not by convenience: in a text input the space bar types a space and changes the value, so the snapshot sees a change for any printable key. Absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect — a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not.

props.name: items
props.description: The options, as data: {value, label} — or groups of them, {label, items}. Grouping is the engine's own shape: the same `items` prop takes either, and the kind is read from the first element. Do not mix flat with grouped.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns off the field and both buttons at once.

props.name: empty
props.description: What the list shows when nothing matches. A fixed string cannot say 'no fruit by that name', and the engine always allowed the content to be written.

props.name: size
props.description: The system's size step, not the HTML character count — it paints the inner input with the same .input-sm/.input-lg skin as the rest of the field family. Responsive: it resolves in the CSS layer, so it costs no observer.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the INPUT, not of the container — it is what a <label htmlFor> has to point at. Without it one is generated.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the field wrapper, not onto the input.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Goes to the input, which is the focusable node. It is spelled out because this component unpacks a fixed list of props and silently drops anything else — that is what kept Field from reaching the input (AUD-0001).

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Same route and same reason as aria-describedby: the input carries it, the wrapper would not announce it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label — a filter in a grid without labels (C-01). With `label`, prefer `label`.
